title: Molecular basis for coordinating secondary metabolite production by bacterial and plant signaling molecules.
authors: Zhang, Nannan; Wu, Jin; Zhang, Siping; Yuan, Maoran; Xu, Hang; Li, Jie; Zhang, Pingping; Wang, Mingzhu; Kempher, Megan L; Tao, Xuanyu; Zhang, Li-Qun; Ge, Honghua; He, Yong-Xing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌TetR家族调控因子PhlH与配体及DNA结合的变构机制，采用晶体结构和分子动力学模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA特异性结合预测，但属于蛋白-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The production of secondary metabolites is a major mechanism used by beneficial rhizobacteria to antagonize plant pathogens. These bacteria have evolved to coordinate the production of different secondary metabolites due to the heavy metabolic burden imposed by secondary metabolism. However, for most secondary metabolites produced by bacteria, it is not known how their biosynthesis is coordinated. Here, we showed that PhlH from the rhizobacterium Pseudomonas fluorescens is a TetR-family regulator coordinating the expression of enzymes related to the biosynthesis of several secondary metabolites, including 2,4-diacetylphloroglucinol (2,4-DAPG), mupirocin, and pyoverdine. We present structures of PhlH in both its apo form and 2,4-DAPG-bound form and elucidate its ligand-recognizing and allosteric switching mechanisms. Moreover, we found that dissociation of 2,4-DAPG from the ligand-binding domain of PhlH was sufficient to allosterically trigger a pendulum-like movement of the DNA-binding domains within the PhlH dimer, leading to a closed-to-open conformational transition. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations confirmed that two distinct conformational states were stabilized by specific hydrogen bonding interactions and that disruption of these hydrogen bonds had profound effects on the conformational transition. Our findings not only reveal a well-conserved route of allosteric signal transduction in TetR-family regulators but also provide novel mechanistic insights into bacterial metabolic coregulation.
abstract_zh: 次级代谢产物的产生是有益根际细菌拮抗植物病原体的主要机制。这些细菌因次级代谢带来的沉重代谢负担，已进化出协调不同次级代谢产物产生的能力。然而，对于细菌产生的大多数次级代谢产物，其生物合成如何协调尚不清楚。在此，我们展示了来自根际细菌荧光假单胞菌（*Pseudomonas fluorescens*）的PhlH是一种TetR家族调控因子，协调多种次级代谢产物（包括2,4-二乙酰基间苯三酚（2,4-DAPG）、莫匹罗星和pyoverdine）生物合成相关酶的表达。我们解析了PhlH在无配体（apo）形式和2,4-DAPG结合形式下的结构，并阐明了其配体识别和变构切换机制。此外，我们发现2,4-DAPG从PhlH配体结合域解离足以变构触发PhlH二聚体内DNA结合域的钟摆式运动，导致从闭合到开放的构象转变。最后，分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟证实，两种不同的构象状态通过特异性氢键相互作用得以稳定，而这些氢键的破坏对构象转变产生深远影响。我们的发现不仅揭示了TetR家族调控因子中一条高度保守的变构信号转导途径，还为细菌代谢协同调控提供了新的机制见解。
